title: sqlite vars
description: Configuration variables for the SQLite database engine and C amalgamation source builder

SQLITE_VERSION.description: Specific version of SQLite to install or compile (e.g., '3.46.1' or 'latest').

SQLITE_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install SQLite ('libscript_native' prebuilt binary, 'from-source' compiled from the C amalgamation, 'system' via OS/selected package manager, or third-party version managers).

SQLITE_PKG_MGR.description: Specific package manager to use when installing SQLite via package manager (e.g., apt-get, apk, dnf, brew, winget, choco, scoop, nix, vcpkg).

SQLITE_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN.description: Build toolchain used when SQLITE_INSTALL_METHOD='from-source' ('default' uses platform default C compiler; 'gcc', 'clang', 'tcc', 'custom-cc', or a binary path uses that custom compiler).

SQLITE_COMPILER.description: Alias for SQLITE_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN specifying the C compiler for source builds.

SQLITE_CFLAGS.description: Compiler flags passed when compiling the SQLite amalgamation from source.

SQLITE_LDFLAGS.description: Linker flags passed when linking the SQLite CLI and library from source.

SQLITE_SINGLE_THREADED.description: When true, compiles SQLite with -DSQLITE_THREADSAFE=0 and -DSQLITE_OMIT_LOAD_EXTENSION=1 for minimal C compilers.

SQLITE_AMALGAMATION_URL.description: Optional explicit download URL for the SQLite C amalgamation archive.

SQLITE_AMALGAMATION_YEAR.description: Release year directory on sqlite.org used when constructing the default amalgamation URL.

SQLITE_BUILD_SHARED_LIB.description: Whether to also compile the shared library (libsqlite3.so / libsqlite3.dylib / sqlite3.dll) during from-source builds.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global unix socket to listen on

SQLITE_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port for SQLITE to listen on

SQLITE_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Address for SQLITE to listen on

SQLITE_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Unix socket for SQLITE to listen on

SQLITE_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading sqlite binary or archive artifacts.

SQLITE_PATH.description: Filesystem directory or path configuration for sqlite (SQLITE_PATH).

SQLITE_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying sqlite available remote releases.
